segments.he:
א.

מִי שֶׁלֹּא תִּקֵּן חַטַּאת נְעוּרִים, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה בָּאִים לוֹ דְּאָגוֹת.
segments.en: One who has not rectified the sins of his youth, through this worries come upon him.

segments.he:
ב.

לְרֹב בָּא הַצַּעַר לָאָדָם עַל-יְדֵי דִּבּוּרוֹ.
segments.en: For the most part, suffering comes to a man through his speech.

segments.he:
ג.

כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לְךָ צַעַר, תְּדַבֵּר מִזֶּה הַצַּעַר.
segments.en: When you are suffering, speak about this suffering. Through worries of the heart, there falls upon the person fear of death.

segments.he:
ד.

עַל-יְדֵי דְּאָגָה בַּלֵּב נוֹפֵל עַל הָאָדָם אֵימַת מָוֶת.
segments.en: Through submission, evil and sorrow are annulled. One who is depressed should gaze upon the Tzaddikim, and joy will come to his heart.

segments.he:
ה.

עַל-יְדֵי הַכְנָעָה נִתְבַּטֵּל רָעָה וְיָגוֹן.
segments.en: When you enter the house of a non-Jew, through this depression comes [upon you].

segments.he:
ו.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ עַצְבוּת, יִסְתַּכֵּל עַל הַצַּדִּיקִים, וְיָבֹא לוֹ שִׂמְחָה בְּלִבּוֹ.
segments.en: Through depression one becomes weakened. Through an evil heart, one's face is transformed. When you have anguish on a day of joy, and all your happiness is dispelled, know that your ancestral merit has been exhausted.

segments.he:
ז.

כְּשֶׁאַתָּה נִכְנָס בְּבֵית נָכְרִי, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה בָּא עַצְבוּת.
segments.en: One who is depressed should continually give a gift to a Tzaddik. Through depression come fires (burnings).

segments.he:
ח.

עַל-יְדֵי עַצְבוּת אָדָם נֶחֱלָשׁ.
segments.en: Depression is a sign that some disease is about to manifest.

segments.he:
ט.

עַל-יְדֵי לֵב רָע הַפָּנִים נִשְׁתַּנֶּה.
segments.en: Due to depression, the Holy One, Blessed be He, is not with him.

segments.he:
י.



כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לְךָ צַעַר בְּיוֹם שִׂמְחָה, וְכָל שִׂמְחָתְךָ נִשְׁבָּת, תֵּדַע שֶׁתַּמָּה זְכוּת אֲבוֹתֶיךָ.
segments.en: Through depression, one has (lit. sees) a wanton seminal emission. Depression comes through anger. Through depression, a person does not reach his aspiration.

segments.he:
יא.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ עַצְבוּת, יִתֵּן מַתָּנָה לַצַּדִּיק תָּדִיר.
segments.en: Due to depression, one is degraded. Due to weeping, a person is unable to eat.

segments.he:
יב.

עַל-יְדֵי עַצְבוּת בָּא שְׂרֵפָה.
segments.en: One who is not depressed, but is always joyful, will certainly be raised up.

segments.he:
יג.

עַצְבוּת סִימָן לְאֵיזֶה חֹלָאַת, שֶׁמְּמַשְׁמֵשׁ לָבוֹא.
segments.en: Through depression comes degradation. Crying is a positive sign for a sick person.

segments.he:
יד.

עַל-יְדֵי עַצְבוּת הַקָּדוֹשׁ-בָּרוּךְ-הוּא אֵין עִמּוֹ.
segments.en: Through anguish, one's enemies are highly elevated. Through anguish comes heart pain.

segments.he:
טו.

עַל-יְדֵי עַצְבוּת רוֹאֶה קֶרִי.
segments.en: One who is hasty is gloomy (sad/annoyed/irritated).

segments.he:
טז.

עַצְבוּת בָּא עַל-יְדֵי כַּעַס.
segments.en: Drawing close to Tzaddikim makes the heart joyous .

segments.he:
יז.

עַל-יְדֵי עַצְבוּת אֵינוֹ מַשִּׂיג תּוֹחַלְתּוֹ.
segments.en: A segulah for removing depression is to listen to an honored Tzaddik when he sings.

segments.he:
יח.

עַל-יְדֵי עַצְבוּת נִתְבַּזֶּה.
segments.en: One who does not confess his sins has sighing and worries come upon him.

segments.he:
יט.

עַל-יְדֵי בְּכִיָּה אֵין אָדָם יָכוֹל לֶאֱכֹל.
segments.en: When a person lusts after things that are against [the Will of] the Holy One, Blessed be He, through this anguish (sighing) comes upon him.

segments.he:
כ.

מִי שֶׁאֵין לוֹ עַצְבוּת וְהוּא תָּמִיד בְּשִׂמְחָה, בְּוַדַּאי יִתְנַשֵּׂא.
segments.en: Sadness due to a bad dream annuls [the influence of] the dream, preventing it from coming to pass.

segments.he:
כא.

עַל-יְדֵי עַצְבוּת בָּא בִּזָּיוֹן.
segments.en: Voice, appearance, and scent restore a person's wellbeing (lit.

segments.he:
כב.

בְּכִיָּה הוּא סִימָן טוֹב לְחוֹלֶה.
segments.en: knowledge/awareness). Through screaming, one's pain is annulled.

segments.he:
כג.

עַל-יְדֵי יָגוֹן אוֹיְבָיו נִתְרוֹמְמִים.
segments.en: One who is depressed brings suffering upon himself.

segments.he:
כד.

עַל-יְדֵי יָגוֹן בָּא כְּאֵב לֵב.
segments.en: One who draws too far after his own suffering, suffering draws towards him.

segments.he:
כה.

מִי שֶׁהוּא מָהִיר, הוּא עַצְבָן.
segments.en: Dates annul worry. Aggadah (Talmudic legends) brings joy to a man.

segments.he:
כו.

קִרְבַת הַצַּדִּיקִים מְשַׂמֵּחַ אֶת הַלֵּב.
segments.en: Depression [fills] the heart of a man when he becomes aware of his own evil (bad fortune).

segments.he:
כז.

סְגֻלָּה לְהָסִיר עַצְבוּת, שֶׁיִּשְׁמַע אֶת צַדִּיק נִכְבָּד, כְּשֶׁהוּא מְזַמֵּר.
segments.en: For the heart causes all of this, because the heart is the cause of everything; for good or for bad (lit.

segments.he:
כח.

מִי שֶׁאֵין מִתְוַדֶּה עַל עֲווֹנוֹתָיו, אֲנָחָה וּדְאָגוֹת בָּאִים עָלָיו.
segments.en: the opposite). One must guard himself from depression in order that he not come to mourning, G-d forbid.

segments.he:
כט.

כְּשֶׁאָדָם מִתְאַוֶּה לִדְבָרִים שֶׁהֵם נֶגְדִּיִּים לַקָּדוֹשׁ-בָּרוּךְ-הוּא, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה בָּא לוֹ אֲנָחָה.
segments.en: Through suffering and sadness, conflict comes into the world. Conversely, through joy, peace comes to the world. Through the spoiling of one's joy, sicknesses come upon him.

segments.he:
ל.

הָעֶצֶב עַל חֲלוֹם רָע מְבַטֵּל אֶת הַחֲלוֹם, שֶּׁלֹּא יִתְקַיֵּם.
segments.en: It is a segulah to remove depression through mercy.

segments.he:
לא.

קוֹל וּמַרְאֶה וְרֵיחַ מְשִׁיבִין דַּעְתּוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם.
segments.en: 19. Due to weeping, a person is unable to eat.

segments.he:
לב.

עַל-יְדֵי הַצְּעָקָה נִתְבַּטֵּל הַצַּעַר.
segments.en: 20. One who is not depressed, but is always joyful, will certainly be raised up.

segments.he:
לג.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ עַצְבוּת, מֵבִיא עַל עַצְמוֹ יִסּוּרִין.
segments.en: 21. Through depression comes degradation.

segments.he:
לד.

כָּל הַנִּמְשָׁךְ אַחַר צַעֲרוֹ יוֹתֵר מִדַּי, הַצַּעַר נִמְשָׁךְ אַחֲרָיו.
segments.en: 22. Crying is a positive sign for a sick person.

segments.he:
לה.

תְּמָרִים מְבַטְּלִין דְּאָגָה.
segments.en: 23. Through anguish, one's enemies are highly elevated.

segments.he:
לו.

אַגָּדָה מְשַׂמֵּחַ אֶת הָאָדָם.
segments.en: 24. Through anguish comes heart pain.

segments.he: חֵלֶק שֵׁנִי

א.

עַצְבוּת שֶׁבְּלֵב הָאָדָם, כְּשֶׁמַּרְגִּישׁ בְּרָעָתוֹ, כִּי הַלֵּב הוּא הַמֵּסֵב לְכָל זֶה, כִּי הַלֵּב הוּא הַגּוֹרֵם לְכָל דָּבָר הֵן לְטוֹב הֵן לְהֵפֶךְ.
segments.en: 25. One who is hasty is gloomy (sad/annoyed/irritated).

segments.he:
ב.

צָרִיךְ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת עַצְמוֹ מֵעַצְבוּת, כְּדֵי שֶּׁלֹּא יָבוֹא, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, לִידֵי אֲבֵלוּת.
segments.en: 26. Drawing close to Tzaddikim makes the heart joyous .

segments.he:
ג.

עַל-יְדֵי הַצַּעַר וְהָעַצְבוּת בָּא מְרִיבָה בָּעוֹלָם, וְעַל-יְדֵי הַשִּׂמְחָה בָּא שָׁלוֹם בָּעוֹלָם.
segments.en: 27. A segulah for removing depression is to listen to an honored Tzaddik when he sings.

segments.he:
ד.

עַל-יְדֵי קִלְקוּל הַשִּׂמְחָה בָּא חֳלָאִים עָלָיו.
segments.en: 28. One who does not confess his sins has sighing and worries come upon him.

segments.he:
ה.

סְגֻלָּה לְהָסִיר הָעַצְבוּת עַל-יְדֵי הָרַחֲמָנוּת.
segments.en: 29. When a person lusts after things that are against [the Will of] the Holy One, Blessed be He, through this anguish (sighing) comes upon him.

segments.he:
ו.

הַנְּדָרִים וְהַנְּדָבוֹת מְבִיאִין שִׂמְחָה.
segments.en:
30. Sadness due to a bad dream annuls [the influence of] the dream, preventing it from coming to pass.

Vows and pledges bring happiness.
